rows.answer: For retail claims, you must submit the claim within 30 days of discharge [2][4]. For group corporate plan claims, the submission window is 60 days from discharge [5].
The room rent limit on the Silver plan is 2% of the sum insured per day [5][6].
Maternity cover is not available on the Bronze plan at any sum insured [1][4].

Hypertension, diabetes mellitus, and cardiac conditions declared at the proposal stage are treated as pre-existing and carry a 36-month waiting period unless Aurora explicitly waives it in writing on the policy schedule [3].
The grace period is 30 days from the renewal due date for annual policies [1].
Aurora's network covers 11,400 hospitals across 780 towns as of 1 April 2026 [1].

The no-claim bonus on Aurora Gold is 25% of the base sum insured per claim-free year, accumulating to a maximum of 100% [3]. The bonus is not reduced by a claim, but it stops accumulating for that year only [3].
No, infertility, assisted reproduction, IVF, surrogacy, and sterilisation reversal are permanently excluded and never payable under any Aurora indemnity plan [1][3].
The cataract surgery sub-limit on Aurora Gold is ₹75,000 per eye [2].

If you are not satisfied with the Stage 1 outcome, you can escalate to Aurora's Grievance Redressal Officer [2]. If Aurora's final response remains unsatisfactory, you may approach the Insurance Ombudsman for your region [3].
Ambulance cover is ₹5,000 per hospitalisation for road ambulance only [2].

In-patient treatment for mental illness is covered on the same terms as physical illness, as required by the Mental Healthcare Act 2017 [2]. The 30-day initial waiting period applies, and no separate waiting period does [2].
The free-look period is 15 days from receipt, or 30 days for policies sold through distance marketing [3][4]. It is the window in which a new policy can be returned for a refund [5].
You receive 150 points for completing an annual health check-up [2].

A day-care procedure is a procedure that requires less than 24 hours of hospitalisation because of technological advance, and is therefore payable despite the general 24-hour admission requirement [5]. Out-patient treatment is not a day-care procedure [5].
For an emergency admission using the cashless route, the hospital must notify Aurora within 24 hours of admission [2].
Aurora administers its own claims and does not use a Third Party Administrator (TPA) [3].
To qualify as a hospital under the policy, a facility must have at least 10 in-patient beds in towns with a population below 10 lakh, or 15 in-patient beds elsewhere [2].

No, not everything will be paid [3]. Pharmacy and consumables are paid in full, but everything tied to the room category is proportionately reduced because the room rent of ₹15,000 per day exceeds your limit of ₹10,000 per day [1][2][3].

Silver, Gold, and Platinum plans allow dependent parents to be covered [1]. Silver covers dependent parents at an extra premium, while Gold and Platinum include them [1]. Adding a dependent parent to a floater often costs more than an individual senior-citizen policy for that parent because the premium is determined by the age of the eldest member covered [4]. Aurora's advisers are required to present both options in writing before the sale [4].

Waiting periods already served with a previous Indian insurer carry over when you port your policy, but only up to the sum insured of the previous policy [3][4]. Any increase in the sum insured or any excess sum insured is subject to fresh waiting periods [3][4].

To continue the newborn's cover beyond 90 days, you must inform Aurora within 90 days of birth and add the newborn to the policy as a dependent [3]. Doing so within this 90-day window is guaranteed-issue with no medical underwriting [3].

A claim in any year reduces the accumulated no-claim bonus by 10 percentage points [3]. It does not reset the bonus to zero [3].
On the Gold plan, the maternity limit for a caesarean section is ₹1,00,000 [2]. If the hospital bills ₹1,60,000, you would pay ₹60,000 out of pocket [2].
Knee joint replacement has a waiting period of 24 months, unless it follows an accident [3]. Therefore, it is not covered immediately after buying the policy unless it follows an accident [3][4].
Total discounts are capped at 30% of base premium [3]. However, the wellness discount is applied last after the cap, and is the only discount that may exceed it, reaching up to 15% at renewal [2][3].

If a hospital is an excluded provider, cashless access is denied [3][4]. However, claims from excluded providers are payable on a reimbursement basis only if the admission was a genuine emergency and no alternative facility was reachable [1][2].
You have 45 days from the date of the query to respond to an Aurora query [1]. For motor insurance claims, the deadline to respond to an Aurora query is 30 days from the date of the query [5].
For a planned cashless admission, the hospital must notify Aurora 72 hours before admission [1].

Aurora settles or rejects a complete reimbursement claim within 15 working days of receiving the last required document [3][4]. If Aurora raises a query, the clock restarts when you supply the queried document [3].
Aurora Gold has a nil co-payment at all ages [3][6].

The pre-hospitalisation cover is 30 days for the first plan, 45 days for the second plan, 60 days for the third plan, and 90 days for the fourth plan [2]. The post-hospitalisation cover is 60 days for the first plan, 90 days for the second plan, 120 days for the third plan, and 180 days for the fourth plan [2].
You should buy the Gold plan, as it covers dependent parents-in-law [1] and removes room-rent sub-limits [5].

Out-patient dental work is among the most commonly misunderstood items not covered by any plan [3]. Dental treatment and oral surgery are excluded unless necessitated by an accidental injury requiring hospitalisation [4].

The grace period is 30 days from the renewal due date for annual policies and 15 days for policies paid in instalments [1]. If you renew after the grace period expires, the policy is treated as fresh, all waiting periods restart, accumulated no-claim bonus is lost, and fresh underwriting applies [3].
No, you are not finished, as you can use Route 2 for reimbursement at non-network hospitals or where cashless was denied [4].

Completing the quit-tobacco programme earns 200 points per year toward the wellness programme [4]. Points convert to a renewal-premium discount at a rate of 1,000 points equal to 5%, up to a cap of 15% [5].
